description:
Read a file (up to 1 MiB). Text comes back as text; other bytes as base64 with encoding='base64'.
    Works on your workspaces and any public one. For larger files use get_file_link. With `receipt` (0.62.0), the
    exact bytes of that save (the number file_history's receipts give), so a citation `<path>@<receipt>` can be
    re-fetched and checked against its sha256; older saves are for the workspace's members, and a deleted file's
    saves aren't served.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

receipt.description: Optional: a save's number (file_history's receipts; the files listing gives the latest) to read exactly the bytes of that save instead of the current ones.
receipt.title: Receipt

workspace_id.description: The workspace's id (a UUID), from create_workspace, list_workspaces or the store.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: read_file
